title: Observe European descriptors in Ability navigation
changes: Record bounded ordinary Ability navigation using the EUR conditional descriptor banks.
validation: One focused Wine production run of an existing 540-frame input served 52 pointer bytes and six bytes from each of fields 0 and 2; 212 guarded files and 699 frozen source hashes remained unchanged.
limitations: Counters are aggregate and fields 4, kind and byte 7 were not exercised; full scene comparison, other fields, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
